title: With business growth comes challenges. This is one business decision ...
description: With business growth comes challenges. This is one business decision I’ve made that has saved me money and also taken away the mental load of buying new laptops for the team. I signed up to HP Advantage for Small Business because I received a members-only discount of up to 25% off and even better discounts when purchasing more than five devices. I also get access to leasing options, which means I can get the laptops I want and pay them off over five years. Plus, they provide a business specialist to help me choose the right machine for the type of work we’re doing. If you’re looking to upgrade your small business tools, I highly recommend signing up to HP Advantage for Small Business.
